description: Replace a file's content and/or summary; only given fields change. Content is inline, at most 50000 characters. Directories cannot be updated. `pluginId` targets another plugin of the project instead of the installed one.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).

summary.description: The new summary; null or "" clears it.

name: plugins_files_update
title: Update plugin file
